`./compile.sh` reports **`compiled OK`**.

## What was delivered

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang/EntitiesAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching the JUnit 4.x jars in `lib/`), in package `org.apache.commons.lang` so it can reach the package-private `Entities` class and its package-private no-arg constructor.

### Design notes
- **Encoding-proof**: every non-ASCII character (`¡`, `nbsp`, `©`, `∀`, Greek letters, `½`, `é`) is built at runtime from its code point via a private `ch(int)` helper, so results don't depend on `javac`'s default charset (`compile.sh` sets no `-encoding`).
- **Only reads** the shared `Entities.XML` / `HTML32` / `HTML40` singletons; custom entities are only ever added to fresh `new Entities()` instances, so tests don't interfere with each other.
- `-source 1.6` safe: no diamonds/lambdas/TWR, no underscore literals.

### Coverage (34 tests), all grounded in `api/`
| Area | Cases |
|---|---|
| `addEntity`/`entityName`/`entityValue` | round-trips (single + multiple), the exact javadoc example (`"foo"`→`0xA1`), unknown value → `null`, two names sharing one value |
| `addEntities(String[][])` | every `{name, decimalValue}` row registered; empty array is a no-op |
| `escape(String)` | registered char → `&name;` (javadoc example), only registered chars touched, plain ASCII unchanged, empty string, `Entities.XML` for the 5 XML entities individually + one pass |
| `unescape(String)` | `&name;` → char (javadoc example), unknown entity unchanged, missing `;` unchanged, text with bare `&` unchanged, empty string, adjacent `&` entities, full round-trips |
| `Writer` overloads | `escape`/`unescape` to a `StringWriter` produce the same result as the `String` overloads |
| `XML` vs `HTML32` vs `HTML40` | distinct instances; `nbsp`/`copy` shared by both HTML sets; `apos` is XML-only (HTML40 leaves `'` and `'` alone); `∀` known to HTML40 but not HTML32; Latin-1 escape/unescape round-trip |
